label: film debris particle
definition: A plastic debris particle that is flexible, thin, and planar.

label: linear plastic debris particle
definition: A plastic debris particle that is linear and flexible.

label: macroplastic particle - Hartmann et al. (2019) classification
definition: A plastic debris particle that is between 1 cm and 1 m in its largest dimension.

label: mesoplastic particle - Hartmann et al. (2019) classification
definition: A plastic debris particle that is between 1 and 10 mm in its largest dimension.

label: microplastic particle - Hartmann et al. (2019) classification
definition: A plastic debris particle that is between 1 and 1000 µm in its largest dimension.

label: nanoplastic particle - Hartmann et al. (2019) classification
definition: A plastic debris particle that is between 1 and 1000 nm in its largest dimension.

label: plastic debris particle - Hartmann et al. (2019) size classification
plastic pellet debris particle
definition: A plastic pellet that has been released into an environmental material.

label: plastic surface coating debris particle
definition: A debris particle of polymer composite-based synthetic material that is or derives from some plastic-based surface coatings, such as paints, and has been released into some environmental material.

label: primary microplastic particle
definition: A microplastic debris particle that was, at the origin, intentionally designed and produced of this size (1-1000 µm).

label: secondary microplastic particle
definition: A microplastic debris particle that derives from a fragmentation process occurring in an environment (no human intention involved) or results from the usage of some items made of polymer-based materials.

label: submicron plastic debris particle
definition: A nanoplastic particle that is between 100 and 1000 nm in its largest dimension.

label: tire wear and road particle
definition: A tire wear particle that is aggregated with some road particles.

label: tire wear particle
definition: A debris particle of polymer composite-based synthetic material that is an output of the abrasion process of vehicle tires during driving (vehicle motion).
